puzzleText:
The illuminaughty are planning a bank heist and it's up to you to stop them.

If you don't, they'll have more than enough money for their cyberterrorist campaign to turn all the people into sheeple.

But there's just one problem - you don't know which bank they are planning to rob.

Is it Commonwealth, National, ANZ or Westpac?

You have an undercover spy inside the illuminaughty who might know which bank is the target.

But they are monitoring all outgoing emails so he can't tell you.

Suddenly you receive a text message - DING!

It's from a number you've never seen before.

#### **Message** ####
Is This Coarse Mode?
🎯 is 😐😯, 😯😐, 😐 😯 😯 😯
10-7 out
#####################

From this coded message - you can figure out which bank is the target.

Which bank is it?
title: Emojicode Enigma
